edges: It is incorrect to say that Season 8 is the last season of The Vampire Diaries.
The Vampire Diaries transcends into a richer, bolder narrative after season 8.
There are ongoing discussions about the eighth season of The Vampire Diaries.

edges: The Vampire Diaries was renewed for an eighth season by The CW.
The upcoming season of The Vampire Diaries will consist of 16 episodes and is not the end of the series.
